ios.desc:
Migo Games is a fast online multiplayer arcade built for quick battles with friends and rivals. Jump into short rounds, chase scores, climb leaderboards, and unlock power ups across three competitive modes.

MAIL ROUTE
Orbit the neighborhood, read tricky addresses, time each toss, and deliver letters before houses close.

ARROW
Tap to fire, chain circle hits, score fast, and knock rival players out of rhythm.

LAND GRAB
Race across the board, claim tiles, steal territory, dodge collisions, and use boosts or jumps to seize the map.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Quick Play for public matches.
Private rooms with room codes.
Live scores and game over results.
Short rounds for repeat play.
Simple controls with smart strategy.

Migo Games is made for fans of online multiplayer games, arcade action, score chase battles, territory games, casual competition, and fast party play.

quotes.text: I built an app to let you play some small games against others. Phoenix / Elixir on the back end, swift on the front. Hosted on fly.io. There's a web client for "arrow" at https://migo.games, but it's better with the (just a few meg) native clients. Have fun! Let me know what you think! Give me 5 stars if you like it, or if you're super generous, buy the star trail arrows!
